name: Antrim Foodbank
short_description: Trussell Trust foodbank providing emergency food parcels
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network. Provides emergency food and support to local residents in crisis. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Antrim Community Garden
short_description: Community-run garden growing fresh produce for local families
months: this garden provides growing space for residents and donates surplus to local food bank. Volunteer-led with 20+ members.

name: Antrim Food Share Community Fridge
short_description: Public fridge reducing food waste and supporting local families
months: this community fridge allows residents to share surplus food and access free items. Open during library hours.

name: Public Apple Trees
short_description: Community apple trees in Antrim Castle Gardens
description: Several apple trees throughout Antrim Castle Gardens are available for public picking in autumn. Maintained by Antrim in Bloom volunteers.
